svg.title: Gazebo: world, robot, camera view, playback controls, and simulation statistics
svg.desc: A real screenshot of the Week 3 two-joint arm, with numbered labels for a classroom interface tour. Expand the statistics chevron to see simulation time.

g.text: 1 · Pan, orbit, and zoom change the view; they do not move the robot.
2–3 · Gray base, blue first link, orange second link, and green end-effector marker.
4 · Pause stops simulation time. A full restart also restarts ROS nodes and controllers.
5 · Click the chevron beside the percentage to reveal simulation time and real time.
Captured from this demo in Gazebo Harmonic. UI layout can vary with window size.
